nodes.label: Edge Device (Actor)
nodes.rationale: A non-human system actor treated as a first-class authenticating principal: it must pass the same «include» Authenticate gate as every human role, so telemetry ingestion is never an unauthenticated back door.

nodes.label: Submit Sensor Reading (UC23)
nodes.source_location: UML use case diagram, single page
nodes.rationale: Numeric environmental telemetry ingestion (temperature, humidity, ammonia, etc.) — the data source behind the environmental charts and threshold alerting.

nodes.label: Raise Alert
nodes.rationale: Modelled as «extend» on both ingestion paths because alerting is conditional on a threshold or anomaly being breached; the normal ingestion path must stay fast and unconditional, with alert generation firing only on the exceptional branch.

hyperedges.label: Edge Device Provisioning and Telemetry Ingestion Subsystem
